originalTitle: Asian stocks rally as Taiwan leads with 9% rebound in AI trade
summary: Investing.com -- Most Asian stocks rallied on Tuesday, with Taiwan leading regional gains as Nvidia’s reinstatement of founder Jensen Huang revived enthusiasm for the artificial-intelligence trade following last week’s technology-led selloff.
content:
Investing.com -- Most Asian stocks rallied on Tuesday, with Taiwan leading regional gains as Nvidia's reinstatement of founder Jensen Huang revived enthusiasm for the artificial-intelligence trade following last week's technology-led selloff.

Wall Street staged its strongest session since April 2025: the S&P 500 rose 4.7%, the Dow 3% and the Nasdaq Composite 6.5%; the Nasdaq 100 gained 6.9% and Philadelphia Semiconductor Index added 14%.

Nvidia surged 31.5%, its biggest one-day gain in 23 years, adding nearly $1 trillion in value after rising as much as 36%. The rally followed Friday's correction in the S&P 500 and Dow and the Nasdaq's worst weekly loss since March 2020.

Nvidia's board unanimously restored Huang as president, CEO and director, reversing its refusal less than a week earlier. It cited U.S. government input in concluding his return posed no national-security risk; Trump and Vice President JD Vance had pressed for his reinstatement, Reuters reported.

Huang resigned on November 12 after acknowledging an extramarital relationship, amid reports linking a Chinese businesswoman to suspected efforts to divert restricted chips to China; investigations continue.

Asian markets rebound, but Taiwan remains below its recent peak

Taiwan's Weighted Index jumped over 9%, while South Korea's KOSPI climbed 7.1% and Japan's Nikkei 225 advanced 4.1%. Nasdaq 100 futures edged up 0.1% and S&P 500 futures gained 0.2% in Asian trade, after paring much of Monday's surge.

MSCI's Asia-Pacific index excluding Japan rose 4.6%, its biggest daily gain since July 31, rebounding from an eight-month low and snapping an eight-session slide that had neared bear-market territory.

TOPIX gained 2.3%, Australia's S&P/ASX 200 1.8%, New Zealand's NZX 50 2.1% and Singapore's Straits Times 0.9%. Hong Kong's Hang Seng rose 0.3%, China's CSI 300 1% and Shanghai Composite 0.8%.

Markets in India were closed for a public holiday.

Taiwan's rally followed a 17.5% weekly plunge, its steepest since 1991. Even after Tuesday's jump, the TAIEX remained about 20% below its 52-week high of 49,968.92, and was still down 10.1% over one week and 19.9% over one month.

Huang's departure unsettled an AI ecosystem reliant on Nvidia for chips and financing, as investors questioned whether debt-funded data-centre spending could justify valuations. Meanwhile, Anthropic fell 8.5% on its second day of trading after a weak debut.

Chipmakers surge as investors return to AI trade

Chipmakers and suppliers of components, testing equipment, switches, cables and power infrastructure led the rebound. TSMC rose 9.9%, Foxconn 8.1% and Largan Precision 9.9%.

MediaTek and Delta Electronics each gained 10%. SK Hynix rose 8.9%, Samsung Electronics 8.5%, Kioxia 8.2%, Murata 14.9% and Advantest about 15%.

Risks remain around AI supply-demand imbalances, data-centre delays, costs and regulation.

Brent traded near $89.50 after falling 3.5% Monday. Treasury yields rose, with the 10-year at 4.94% and two-year at 4.69%; the dollar neared a 19-month high against the euro and the yen weakened.

Markets priced a December Fed rate increase as virtually certain, up from 89% on Friday, while the chance of a 50-basis-point move was about 5%.

Investors awaited U.S. consumer confidence Tuesday and Wednesday's PCE inflation, income and spending data and revised third-quarter growth before Thursday's Thanksgiving break and December's final Fed meeting.

chineseTitle: 亚洲股市上涨，台湾领涨，AI 交易反弹 9%
chineseSummary: Investing.com——大多数亚洲股市周二上涨，其中台湾股市领涨，因英伟达创始人黄仁勋复职，在上周科技股主导的抛售之后重振了人们对人工智能行业的热情。
chineseContent:
Investing.com——大多数亚洲股市周二上涨，其中台湾股市领涨，因英伟达创始人黄仁勋复职，在上周科技股主导的抛售之后重振了人们对人工智能行业的热情。

华尔街上演了自 2025 年 4 月以来最强劲的交易日：标准普尔 500 指数上涨 4.7%，道指上涨 3%，纳斯达克综合指数上涨 6.5%；纳斯达克 100 指数上涨 6.9%，费城半导体指数上涨 14%。

英伟达股价飙升 31.5%，创 23 年来最大单日涨幅，在上涨 36% 后，市值增加近 1 万亿美元。此前，标准普尔 500 指数和道指以及纳斯达克指数均出现 2020 年 3 月以来最严重的单周跌幅。

英伟达董事会一致恢复黄仁勋的总裁、首席执行官和董事职务，不到一周前又撤销了这一决定。它引用了美国政府的意见来得出他的回国不会构成国家安全风险的结论；据路透社报道，特朗普和副总统万斯曾敦促他复职。

黄在承认婚外情后于 11 月 12 日辞职，有报道称一名中国女商人涉嫌将受限制的芯片转移到中国。调查仍在继续。

亚洲市场反弹，但台湾仍低于近期峰值

台湾加权指数上涨超过 9%，韩国 KOSPI 上涨 7.1%，日本日经 225 指数上涨 4.1%。纳斯达克 100 指数期货小幅上涨 0.1%，标准普尔 500 指数期货在亚洲交易中上涨 0.2%，此前涨幅已回吐大部分。

MSCI 剔除日本的亚太指数上涨 4.6%，为 7 月 31 日以来的最大单日涨幅，从八个月低点反弹，结束了接近熊市区域的八个交易日下滑。

东证指数上涨 2.3%，澳大利亚 S&P/ASX 200 指数上涨 1.8%，新西兰 NZX 50 指数上涨 2.1%，新加坡海峡时报指数上涨 0.9%。香港恒生指数上涨 0.3%，中国沪深 300 指数上涨 1%，上证综指上涨 0.8%。

印度市场因公众假期休市。

台湾股市在每周暴跌 17.5% 后出现反弹，为 1991 年以来的最大跌幅。即使在周二的暴涨之后，台湾证券交易所指数仍比其 52 周高点 49,968.92 点低约 20%，且一周内仍下跌 10.1%，一个月内下跌 19.9%。

黄仁勋的离职扰乱了依赖英伟达芯片和融资的人工智能生态系统，投资者质疑债务资助的数据中心支出是否能够证明估值合理。与此同时，Anthropic 首日表现疲弱，第二天交易日下跌 8.5%。

随着投资者重返人工智能行业，芯片制造商激增

芯片制造商以及零部件、测试设备、交换机、电缆和电力基础设施供应商引领了反弹。台积电上涨 9.9%，富士康上涨 8.1%，大立光电上涨 9.9%。

联发科和台达电子各上涨 10%。 SK海力士上涨8.9%，三星电子上涨8.5%，铠侠上涨8.2%，村田制作所上涨14.9%，爱德万测试约15%。

人工智能供需不平衡、数据中心延误、成本和监管方面的风险仍然存在。

布伦特原油价格在周一下跌 3.5% 后交投于 89.50 美元附近。美国国债收益率上升，10年期国债收益率为4.94%，两年期国债收益率为4.69%；美元兑欧元接近19个月高点，日元走弱。

市场认为美联储 12 月加息几乎是板上钉钉的事情，高于上周五的 89%，而加息 50 个基点的可能性约为 5%。

投资者等待周二和周三的美国消费者信心指数、个人消费支出通胀、收入和支出数据，以及周四感恩节假期和 12 月最后一次美联储会议之前修正的第三季度增长数据。
